question: Who among the following is not associated with Kuchipudi dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghanakanta Bora Borbayan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical dance form that originated in the village of Kuchipudi in Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• It is one of the eight major classical dance forms of India.
 
• It is known for its graceful movements, intricate footwork, and expressive facial expressions.
 
• It is often performed as a solo dance, but can also be performed in groups.
 
• It has a rich history and is believed to have originated in the 17th century.
 
• It was initially performed by male dancers, but later women also started performing the dance form.
 
• It is often accompanied by classical Carnatic music and the dancers wear colorful costumes and jewelry. The dance form is known for its elaborate makeup and costumes.
 
• Some famous exponents of this dance form are ** Mallika Sarabhai**, **V. Satyanarayana Sarma**, **Deepa Shashindran**, **Vyjayanti Kashi**, **Vempati Chinna Satyam**, **Radha Reddy**, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ghana Kanta Bora Borbayan** has been trained in the **Sattriya dance** and music traditions of **Assam **by several eminent gurus.

 
 
• He has also received training at the Kamalabari sattra of Majuli, Assam.
